artifact_class: DEMO -- illustrative end-to-end run of the single-view contract + tiered render on two real HAM10000 images. NOT an evaluation: no test-set metric is computed or claimed; the registered numbers live in ham_evaluation.json and promoted_recipe_ham_bcn.json. E3 test-side images were already read post-hoc under the user-authorized re-read; this demo re-reads two of them.

classifier.config: dermlip + metadata19 (531-d), UNBALANCED LR C=10.0 (train-CV, pooled correct-count, seed 20260812), fit on the E3 train split; ADOPTED ARM = ARGMAX (no operating point -- the Derm7pt-tuned SK/MISC downweights collapse HAM melanoma recall and were never adopted; see finalize_paper_metrics.py)
classifier.fitting_code_path: scripts/dev/promoted_recipe_ham_bcn.py functions (which reuse build_ham_evaluation.make_split), reproducing the ham_e3 five_group candidate_b_promoted_recipe fit; ARGMAX arm (adopted)
classifier.split_verification: E3 partition regenerated via build_ham_evaluation.make_split (seed 20260812) and asserted equal to the recorded train/test cluster_id lists; C selection asserted equal to the recorded candidate_b selection

case_selection_rule: for each of (melanoma, nevus): the FIRST E3-test image in manifest record order whose true label matches and whose argmax prediction agrees -- so the demo exercises the guideline-covered and explicit-absence paths as designed. True labels appear here for demo labeling only; no accuracy claim is made or implied.

encoding.note: the two query images were encoded FRESH from their raw JPGs with the frozen DermLIP encoder (the raw-image entry path); the cached E3 feature rows agree to the reported max |diff| (float32 batched-CPU inference tolerance)
